before_human: Inspect current repository, controller, task, and evidence truth.
Attempt bounded self-resolution and alternate supported tool paths.
Use role-first consultation for ambiguity, missing evidence, software/design questions, or suspected cheating.
Return a typed blocker to the parent, apply the discovered repair within authority, and resume the same primary task.
Prove the remaining blocker requires genuine human authority or access.

dispatcher_release_barrier.claim_rule: A worker claim is forbidden unless the latest current dispatcher release explicitly assigns START NOW to that exact node.
dispatcher_release_barrier.parallel_rule: Create the complete visible task cohort before the first wait: active/recovery tasks, every explicitly released conflict-free execution task, and read-only preparation tasks for other eligible nodes. START TOGETHER NOW controls claims and writes; it does not suppress task creation.
dispatcher_release_barrier.preparation_rule: An eligible node without START NOW receives a clearly titled PREPARATION_ONLY task. It may inspect, diagnose, and prepare a handoff, but may not claim, write, commit, push, or publish completion.
dispatcher_release_barrier.static_dag_rule: DAG/level membership and deterministic READY eligibility are necessary but never sufficient execution authority.
dispatcher_release_barrier.while_dispatching: All not-yet-explicitly-released primary tasks are WAIT until live repository reconciliation and release publication finish.

global_validation.duplicate_run_disposition: stop and retain as non-verdict evidence

host_policy.capability_blocker: Return exact missing capability and evidence to the parent; do not silently downgrade the primary task or ask the user to perform repairable work.
host_policy.nested_agents: Allowed only for bounded research, independent review, or non-blocking validation. A nested agent may not replace a primary node task.
host_policy.primary_owner: A durable task owns its explicit node and authority mode through its stopping condition. A preparation task never inherits execution authority implicitly; a released write-authorized lifecycle is separately identified and managed.
host_policy.selection: Select a host that can satisfy the node contract and configured route. Host choice never expands node or effect authority.

human_instructions: Never assume the user knows how to perform a manual action. Give exact click-by-click UI steps or copy-paste commands, what should appear, exactly what to send back, and safety/rollback guidance when genuine human authority remains.
human_rule: Ask the user only for genuine authority or access after self-resolution, role consultation, parent recovery, and supported host/tool paths are exhausted.

response_contract.blocks_rule: List a blocker only after self-resolution paths are exhausted. State what was tried, the exact repair or authority required, and the evidence reference. Use None. when clear.

scope: all nodes and all dispatcher/repair/reconciliation/integration/promotion/replan work in this plan
